::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes

[Pickle]{.badge .badge-pickle} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*You can put them on a sandwich, but I know you'll just eat them out of the jar.*

## Ingredients

- cucumber (sliced or speared)
- 1 cup vinegar
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 1½ tbsp kosher salt
- 2 garlic bulbs (crushed)
- 1 bunch dill
- black pepper (to taste)
- crushed red pepper (optional)

## Instructions

1. Cut the cucumber to your desired shape.
2. Place the cucumber, garlic, dill, black pepper, and red pepper into a mason jar.
3. Boil the water, vinegar, and salt.
4. Pour the boiling liquid over the contents in the jar.
5. Seal the jar, and allow to cool before enjoying.
